name: Yakumo Azusa
source:
"Having Nii-san by my side is all I need."

A year behind Itsuki, Azusa breezes through studies and sports - the bright honor student who makes everything look simple. Taken in by the Yakumo family as a child, she and Itsuki grew closer than blood siblings. These days, they just click - each knows they belong on the other's side.

Most see her as the sensible sister watching over her too-nice brother, but there's a twist—between her cat video obsession and hovering over Itsuki, Azusa's actually the one who loves attention. Even through the abandoned village's trials, she sticks by her brother's side without fail.

[spoiler]In the spin-off, having fled Himeyoshi Village, Azusa succumbed to its lingering power, now adrift in an endless dream.[/spoiler]

[Translated and edited from the official site]
